t: IFISH: Carp on Fly - Wyangala Dam, NSW
st: Carp on Fly - Wyangala Dam, NSW
d: Mud Marlin, Bogan Bonefish. Call them what you will, European Carp are a whole lot of fun when it comes to casting a fly. Amazing takes, line burning runs and some incredible site fishing... and that is just the begininning.

t: IFISH: Metre Barra on Handline - Daly River, NT
st: Metre Barra on Handline - Daly River, NT
d: The Big Barra Battle goes down this Sunday at 5:30pm on ONE! Where age and technique come into play on the famous Daly River! Arms will be stretched, laughs will be had, rods will be bent, hearts will be broken and third umpires will be called upon.
For your own safety, be sure you have a glass of water with you when watching this episode. We don't want you to perspire during all the NON STOP MARLIN ACTION!

t: IFISH: Mangrove Jack - The Kimberley, NT
d: Paul Worsteling: "Few days fishing actually live up to their expectation, let alone exceed them."  / Jet Worsteling: "Best days fishing I've ever had and at the coolest spot."

t: IFISH: Australian Salmon - Port Lincoln, SA
d: Local knowledge is always best, so when young Archie from Port Lincoln told me we were gonna smash some BIG Australian Salmon off the beach - I knew I was in for one hell of a day!

t: IFISH: Spanish Mackerel - Namotu Island, Fiji
d: The apple doesn't fall far from the tree. Down rigging big live baits, deep dropping for monsters of the deep and popping for those massive surface strikes - what more could Jet and I ask for!

t: IFISH: Black Bream - Bemm River, VIC
d: Traditionally bream fishing is a game of bait and wait... well not if Franks around! Local East Gippsland guru, Frank Milito, gives PW a lesson in using vibes for BIG Bemm River bream, that you really must see!

There is only one thing better than waking up in the remote pristine wilderness of the Kimberley - and that's fishing it!   Join the Worsteling tribe as they navigate their way through dense mangrove systems in search of the mighty BARRAMUNDI!

t: IFISH: Yellowtail Kingfish, Jervis Bay, NSW
d: "Catch the fresh bait, get the BIG fish!" Join the team for a step by step lesson in down rigging fresh baits for big angry Kings!
